title: Sinqatshiwe — Kuchaza Ukuthini Nokuthi Ungafaka Kanjani Isikhalazo Sesibonelelo Se-SASSA
description: Isimo sesibonelelo sakho se-SASSA sibonisa 'Sinqatshiwe' — nakhu okuchazwa yikho, izizathu ezivame kakhulu zokwaliwa, nomhlahlandlela ophelele wokudlulisela isikhalazo ngesibonelelo sakho esinqatshiwe.

seo.metaDescription: Isimo se-SASSA 'Sinqatshiwe' ngo-2026? Funda ukuthi kungani, bese ufaka isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-90 usebenzisa umhlahlandlela wethu we-ITSAA ozinyathelweni.

contentBlocks.title: Sinqatshiwe — Umhlahlandlela Wakho Wokufaka Isikhalazo
contentBlocks.description: Isibonelelo sakho se-SASSA sinqatshiwe — unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo. Thola izizathu ezivame kakhulu zokwaliwa, iwindi lakho lezinsuku ezingama-90 lokufaka isikhalazo, nomhlahlandlela wezinyathelo ngazinye wokufaka isikhalazo esiyimpumelelo kwi-Tribunal Ezimele.

contentBlocks.text: Sinqatshiwe — Kuchaza Ukuthini Ngesibonelelo Sakho Se-SASSA

Ukubona 'Sinqatshiwe' ekuhloleni isimo sakho se-SASSA kungaba nezithukuthuku, kodwa akusona isiphetho. Isimo esinqatshiwe sichaza ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SASSA ezizimele zanquma ukuthi awuhlangabezani nezidingo zokufaneleka zenyanga ehlolwayo. Inyanga ngayinye ihlolwa ngokwehlukana, futhi unelungelo elingokomthetho lokufaka isikhalazo ngenyanga ngayinye onqatshwe kuyo.
Lesi simo sithinta abafake izicelo ezicelo zabo ze-SASSA ezingahlangabezananga nezidingo zokwemukelwa ngemva kokuhlolwa.

contentBlocks.explanation: Isimo 'Sinqatshiwe' sichaza ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ze-SASSA zihlole isicelo sakho ngokuqhathanisa nezidingo zokufaneleka futhi zathola isizathu sokwenqaba isicelo sakho saleyo nyanga ethile. I-SASSA ihlola izizindalwazi eziningi okuhlanganisa i-Home Affairs, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, i-SARS, i-NSFAS, kanye ne-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Ukwaliwa ngenyanga eyodwa akusho ukuthi awukwazi ukufaneleka ezinyangeni ezizayo.
whyItHappens: Kutholwe omunye umthombo wemali engenayo: amadiphozithi asebhange edlula umkhawulo wanyanga zonke we-R624
Kutholwe ukubhaliswa kwe-UIF: umazisi wakho usaxhumene nerekhodi le-UIF elisebenzayo
Kutholwe uxhaso lwe-NSFAS: umazisi wakho ubhaliswe njengomfundi we-NSFAS osebenzayo
Ukuhlolwa kwezimali kwehlulekile: holomali noma izimpahla zakho zidlula imikhawulo engokomthetho
Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhange kwehlulekile: imininingwane yakho yasebhange ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa
Ukuqinisekiswa komazisi kwehlulekile: imininingwane yakho yomazisi ayifani namarekhodi ase-Home Affairs
Udliwelelwa uphenyo lokukhwabanisa: isicelo sakho samakwa ngokungajwayelekile
Kutholwe isicelo esiphindwe kabili: kuthunyelwe izicelo ezingaphezu kwesisodwa ngaphansi komazisi wakho
contentBlocks.howLongItLasts: Isimo esinqatshiwe sisebenza kumjikelezo owodwa wenyanga. Inyanga elandelayo ihlolwa njengesicelo esisha. Kodwa-ke, uma inkinga eyisisekelo (isb., ukubhaliswa kwe-UIF noma amadiphozithi asebhange) iqhubeka, ungase unqatshwe futhi.
whatYouShouldDo: Bheka isaziso sakho sokwaliwa ukuze ubone ikhodi yesizathu ethile
Uma ukholelwa ukuthi ukwaliwa akulungile, faka isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-90
Ngokwemali engenayo ehlobene ne-UIF: thola incwadi yokuyekiswa ye-UI-19 eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi
Ngokwaliwa okuhlobene ne-NSFAS: cela incwadi yokukhanselwa ku-myNSFAS
Ngokwaliwa ngomthombo wemali engenayo: lungisa isifungo esibhaliwe esichaza amadiphozithi asebhange
Ngezinkinga zomazisi: vakashela i-Home Affairs ukuze ulungise imininingwane yakho
Faka isikhalazo ngenyanga ngayinye onqatshwe kuyo ngokwehlukana ku-srd.dsd.gov.za

contentBlocks.title: Unezinsuku Ezingama-90 Lokufaka Isikhalazo
contentBlocks.text: Umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika ukunikeza izinsuku ezingama-90 kusukela ngosuku lokuthola isaziso sakho sokwaliwa ukuze ufake isikhalazo. Izikhalazo ziphethwe yi-Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA), ezimele ngokuphelele ne-SASSA. Awudingi ummeli ukuze ufake isikhalazo.

faqs.question: Ngingafaka isicelo esisha esikhundleni sokufaka isikhalazo?
faqs.answer: Yebo, ungathumela isicelo esisha noma nini. Kodwa-ke, uma isizathu sokwaliwa sisakhona (isb., ukubhaliswa kwe-UIF), kungenzeka unqatshwe futhi. Faka isikhalazo noma ulungise inkinga eyisisekelo kuqala.

faqs.question: Ingabe kumele ngifake isikhalazo nyanga zonke?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Ngenxa yokuthi i-SASSA ihlola ukufaneleka ngenyanga, kumele ufake isikhalazo ngenyanga ngayinye ebonisa isimo 'Sinqatshiwe'.

faqs.question: Kuthiwani uma ngidlule iwindi lezinsuku ezingama-90 lokufaka isikhalazo?
faqs.answer: Ngeshwa, izikhalazo azikwazi ukwamukelwa ngemva kwezinsuku ezingama-90. Kumele uthumele isicelo sesibonelelo esisha ngokuphelele.

faqs.question: Ngingafaka isikhalazo noma nini ehhovisi le-SASSA?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Ngezibonelelo ezingezona ezama-SRD, ungavakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA namadokhumenti akho bese ucela ukuba isikhalazo sifakwe ngesandla. Kwezama-SRD, izikhalazo ziphethwe ngokuyinhloko ku-inthanethi ku-srd.dsd.gov.za.

faqs.question: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani inqubo yokufaka isikhalazo?
faqs.answer: I-tribunal ivamise ukuthatha izinsuku ezingama-60 kuya kwezingama-90 ukukhipha isinqumo. Uma sisemukelwa, i-SASSA kumele ikhokhe izimali ezibuyela emuva phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-14 zokusebenza.
